question_en: What share of Samsung's TDocs led to resolutions? (contribution success rate).
original_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS totalTdocs, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionLinkedTdocs
reference_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'})
WITH DISTINCT t
WITH count(t) AS denominator,
     sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator
RETURN {numerator: numerator, denominator: denominator} AS resolutionLinkedTdocShare

required_fields.name: resolutionLinkedTdocShare
required_fields.source_column_or_expression: exact count(distinct linked Tdoc)/count(distinct all Samsung Tdoc), encoded as an integer numerator/denominator pair

canonical_encoding.denominator: nonzero integer, sign normalized to positive

allowed_equivalent_encodings: typed finite exact JSON number in units of one
explicit percent object with typed finite exact number
rational_share_representation.public_task_rule: Fresh runner public_task hook preserves value-free collection kind/unit/field and required-field codec marker before freeze; unchanged legacy filtering otherwise removes them.
rational_share_representation.decimal_resource_bound: coefficient digits plus absolute base-10 exponent at most 4096; resource rejection retains one invalid unmatched row without expansion
rational_share_representation.raw_decimal_rule: Raw retrieval response and SQL JSON text are parsed with Decimal before canonicalization; native driver float means its available shortest JSON decimal encoding only.
rational_share_representation.invalid_candidate_rule: Malformed individual required-field values and nonobject records remain distinct unmatched rows; matching valid rows retain partial score.
rational_share_representation.all_methods_public_rule: The same value-free exact rational/decimal/explicit-percent specification is in every method public contract before any call.
rational_share_representation.ordinary_contract_rule: Undeclared contracts use original parser, decoder and scorer without share normalization.
